reasoning: Ascariasis is caused by Ascaris roundworms and is one of the most common helminthic infections globally. Despite decades of research, no effective vaccine has been developed for ascariasis, though various candidates have been explored. The disease is primarily managed through anthelmintic drugs rather than vaccination. Given that we're now in 2024 and no vaccine exists, the timeline to November 2025 is very short (~1.5 years). While vaccine development has accelerated in recent years, developing and validating a new vaccine typically takes several years. The probability of a vaccine being documented on Wikipedia's infectious disease list by November 2025 is very low.
